La racine de Ressoude-Os, particulièrement connue dans les vallées méridionales des Montagnes Blanches, est consommée pour favoriser la réparation des fractures. This root is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in mountains, and is best known in western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

The root of Boneset, best known from the southern valleys of the White Mountains, is swallowed to encourage broken bones to mend. It triples the natural rate of bone healing, provided the fragments have first been correctly aligned by ordinary treatment. It is therefore valuable for injuries that would otherwise require prolonged immobilisation.
